sources.title: Second-quarter 2026 earnings release
sources.excerpt: July 30, 2026; quarter ended June 30, 2026. Tables in millions USD except per share. TTM revenue 775,680; net income 135,281; diluted EPS 12.44; operating cash flow 161,403; purchases of property and equipment (173,028); proceeds from property/equipment sales and incentives 4,021; net purchases 169,007; issuer FCF (7,604). June 30 cash and equivalents 78,213; marketable securities 44,775; long-term debt 128,894; long-term lease liabilities 94,338. Common shares outstanding 10,783 million June 30 versus 10,731 million December 31, 2025. Q2 revenue 200,606; operating income 27,461; GAAP net income 62,647 and EPS 5.75; other income 53,415 primarily Anthropic investments. AWS sales 42,232, growth 37%, operating income 16,621, margin 39.4%; North America sales 116,177, operating income 9,123, margin 7.9%; International sales 42,197, operating income 1,717, margin 4.1%. Advertising 19,809, growth 26%; third-party services 46,780, growth 16%; online stores 70,432, growth 15%; subscriptions 13,730, growth 12%. TTM SBC 19,314; H1 SBC 10,070. TTM finance-lease principal repayments 1,599, financing-obligation principal 308, assets acquired under finance leases 4,048, assets acquired under operating leases 24,897, PP&E acquired not yet paid increase 29,267. H1 long-term debt proceeds 66,998. Shipping costs Q2 27,873, growth 19%, paid units growth 17%; third-party unit mix 61%. Q3 guidance revenue 197-202 billion, operating income 22.5-26.5 billion; Prime Day moved to June; excluding event timing growth nearly 400bp higher. AI business and chips business each over 25 billion annual revenue run rates, not additive independent segment sales. Prime first-half same-day/overnight items over 40% higher. Quarterly AWS growth sequence Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 2025 17%/17%/20%/24%, Q1/Q2 2026 28%/37%.

sources.title: Amazon hikes 2026 capex to $220 billion
sources.excerpt: July30 updated July31 2026. Q2 EPS $1.97 adjusted, revenue $200.61B, AWS $42.2B and ads $19.81B. Quarter capex $54.2B; issuer TTM FCF outflow $7.6B; AWS backlog $496B. Q2 net income $62.6B, EPS $5.75 includes $53.4B pretax primarily Anthropic investment income. sources.title: FTC e-commerce antitrust complaint announcement
sources.excerpt: September26 2023: FTC and 17 state attorneys general sued Amazon, alleging exclusionary anti-discounting conduct and conditioning Prime eligibility on costly fulfillment service; allegations also concern paid search ads, own-product preference and seller fees. Seeks permanent injunction. FTC states complaint issued on reason-to-believe standard: allegations are not adjudicated conclusions. This source does not establish October2026 litigation schedule or outcome.

sources.title: FTC expands Amazon Prime settlement redress
sources.excerpt: September17 2026: Amazon accelerates/expands payments under 2025 $2.5B Prime settlement ($1.5B consumer redress plus $1B civil penalty). More than $845M redress paid as of September2026. Federal court approved revised order; automatic expanded eligibility payments start October1 2026; further supplemental payments could begin April2027. Resolves allegations of nonconsensual enrollment and difficult cancellation, separate from e-commerce monopoly case.

price.note: Regular-session close, 16:00 EDT; not the separately quoted 262.53 after-hours. Post-2022 split share basis; no ADR.

shares.note: Actual single-class common shares outstanding at June30, not Q2 diluted weighted average 10,903m or vendor filing-date 10,786m. Millions multiplied by 1000000. Not current Oct9 exact outstanding shares; current quote shares 10.79B broadly consistent but not an observation for June30.

market_cap.note: Rounded 2.83 trillion regular-session snapshot across common equity. FinHacker independent publisher aggregates upstream data; not issuer audit assurance.

revenue.note: Consolidated sales; original millions USD converted to dollars.

net_income.note: Consolidated GAAP net income; includes large noncash/non-operating Anthropic marks. Not normalized income. Original millions converted.

operating_cash_flow.note: Consolidated same-period reported OCF; includes SBC addback and working-capital timing. Original millions converted.

capital_expenditure.note: Positive gross cash purchases of PP&E. Same TTM as OCF. Original negative spending sign changed to positive; millions converted. Does not net 4,021m proceeds/incentives and excludes noncash lease additions, finance lease principal and acquisitions.

eps.note: GAAP diluted TTM per-share earnings on current split basis. Investment marks materially boost denominator; not forward or normalized.

cash.note: Consolidated cash/equivalents only. Excludes 44,775m marketable securities and vendor 283m restricted cash. No assertion all balances distributable. Original millions converted.

debt.note: Vendor standardized251635m includes current/noncurrent borrowings and operating/finance lease liabilities. Sole directly matching observation StockAnalysis; primary noncurrent128894m differs from standardized137794m by8900m, bridge unobserved. Trefis actually displays223.2B in Now10/11/26 table with cash123.0B; no compatible balance period/scope, not canonical observation. WallStSmart header223.23B plus visible historical65650m long-term line also lacks matchingJune2026 aggregate. Finbox/Yahoo failed; search-linked FastEDGAR note actually belonged to Jazz Pharmaceuticals and was rejected, not Amazon evidence. No false corroboration or net debt metric.

forward_eps.note: Analyst consensus non-GAAP adjusted forecast, not reported EPS and not author-verified normalized owner earnings. Vendor adjustment bridge unavailable; must retain SBC economics and dilution in scenario judgment, not assume marks recur.

required_return.period: Five-year annual required price-only return assumption as of 2026-10-11
required_return.note: 11% nominal USD equity hurdle versus observed 5.24% Treasury, reflecting ordinary equity opportunity cost and volatile capital-intensive reinvestment; operating downside separately in scenarios, unmodeled regulatory tails not hidden in rate.

risk_free_rate.note: Observed 10-year USD Treasury par yield 5.24%; percent converted to decimal. Current common reference, not a hardcoded tool default.

marketable_securities.note: Separate from cash; original millions converted.

issuer_free_cash_flow.note: Issuer net-spend FCF nets sale/incentive proceeds. Not engine gross-capex FCF.

stock_based_compensation.note: Reported SBC noncash expense added back to OCF; still economic compensation and possible dilution.
